_doc: Which skill folders a box must NOT carry. Every box pulls all of main; harness/bin/desk.py apply (run by the SessionStart hook) hides the listed folders on the boxes whose identity matches, via git sparse-checkout, so a pull can never bring them back. Identity = hostname / COMPUTERNAME / local username / harness/.operator slug, matched case-insensitively as a substring. Edit, commit, push - the box applies it on its next session.
_doc_drafts_only: Desks that may BUILD a draft but must never press Add. Three things read this list: `sapb1 add-draft` refuses outright on these boxes (sap-b1/cli/internal/config/desk.go), the SessionStart hook puts the policy in the AI's context (harness/bin/desk.py policy), and the exclude rule below takes the submit skill off the box. Same identity matching as `exclude`. Add a desk here when the operator submits and posts the documents herself.

drafts_only.note: Mahak - GRPO desk. Nothing from this desk reaches the approver: `add-draft` is refused, and a GRPO is POSTED LIVE rather than drafted (`sapb1 post PurchaseDeliveryNotes`), because a drafted GRPO lands in Bhawani's queue and SAP refuses this login a GRPO draft in JIVO_MART anyway (-6006). Every other doctype still stops at the draft and the operator presses Add herself in the SAP B1 client. Daman 2026-09-03, GRPO route changed 2026-09-04.

exclude.note: Mahak - drafts only, so the skill that submits to the approver never loads. Daman 2026-09-03
